headline.title: Amazing Digital Dentures (a failed project)
headline.summary: The article discusses the failed project "Amazing Digital Dentures," which aimed to innovate the denture manufacturing process using digital technology. Despite initial promise, the project ultimately did not succeed in bringing its vision to fruition.

articles.title: OpenAI is still working on that ‘super app’
articles.summary: OpenAI continues to develop its "super app," despite claims from a senior employee that traditional chat interfaces are becoming obsolete. The company is focusing on integrating various functionalities into a single platform to enhance user experience.

articles.title: AI ‘content creators’ are getting harder to spot
articles.summary: AI-generated content is becoming increasingly difficult to distinguish from human-created material, as advancements in technology enhance the sophistication of AI influencers. This trend raises concerns about authenticity and trust in digital media.

articles.title: Notion restores access to Anthropic after service disruption
articles.summary: Notion has restored access to Anthropic following a service disruption that garnered significant attention on social media. The company's head of product expressed surprise at the level of public interest in the incident.

articles.title: NVIDIA, KRAFTON, NC and Reigning ‘League of Legends’ Champions T1 Celebrate RTX Spark at Korea’s PC Bangs
articles.summary: NVIDIA recently introduced its RTX Spark superchip at GTC Taipei, designed to enhance Windows PCs for personal AI agents. Following this announcement, CEO Jensen Huang presented the technology to South Korea's gaming community, alongside major developers like KRAFTON and the reigning 'League of Legends' champions, T1.

articles.title: What to expect from WWDC 2026: Siri’s highly anticipated revamp and Apple Intelligence updates
articles.summary: At WWDC 2026, Apple is expected to unveil a significant revamp of Siri, along with updates to its Apple Intelligence platform. The event will focus on enhancing user experience and integrating advanced AI capabilities into Apple's ecosystem.

articles.title: The mayor of Shelbyville, Indiana, says only people who live in ‘shitty houses’ oppose data center
articles.summary: Shelbyville, Indiana's mayor, Scott Furgeson, sparked controversy by suggesting that only residents of "shitty houses" oppose a proposed $2 billion data center in the city. The comments were made in response to growing opposition and the visibility of "No Data Center" signs in the community.

articles.title: OpenAI unveils Lockdown Mode to protect sensitive data from prompt injection attacks
articles.summary: OpenAI has introduced Lockdown Mode for ChatGPT to enhance protection against prompt injection attacks and minimize the risk of sensitive data exposure. While this feature aims to reduce vulnerabilities, experts caution that the model may still be susceptible to certain types of prompt injections.

articles.title: Meta made its own AI-generated clickbait news feed
articles.summary: Meta has launched a new feature in its standalone AI app that generates a "For You" section filled with AI-created clickbait articles. The content, including topics, images, and text, is fully generated by artificial intelligence.

articles.title: Sriram Krishnan is leaving his role as White House AI advisor
articles.summary: Sriram Krishnan is stepping down from his position as White House AI advisor to establish a new institution focused on influencing AI policy under Trump's administration. His departure marks a significant shift in the White House's approach to artificial intelligence initiatives.

articles.title: The Trump administration might take an equity stake in OpenAI
articles.summary: President Donald Trump announced potential discussions regarding the U.S. government taking an equity stake in OpenAI, aiming to ensure that the American public benefits from advancements in artificial intelligence. The initiative reflects the administration's interest in leveraging AI technology for national interests.

articles.title: Crypto-Funded Chinese Peptide Labs Are Booming
articles.summary: Chinese peptide labs are experiencing significant growth, funded by cryptocurrency investments. In related news, hackers are exploiting Meta's AI bots to compromise Instagram accounts, while Anthropic is assisting NSA hackers, and a long-standing GPS satellite mystery appears to have been resolved.
